verdict.rationale: Plausible exposes an Events API for sending pageviews/custom events and a Stats API (/api/v2/query) for reading metrics, but the docs show no API for many UI capabilities—funnels, annotations, goal/site configuration, shared links, SSO, email/Slack reports, embeds—implying these remain UI-only. No OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found, and probes for machine-readable API docs returned 404s, further suggesting incomplete API parity with the UI.
